system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 2 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 1 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (2): Scry the Hearthstone, Skin of the Chameleon
  • Intermediate (2): Armor of Terra, Bond with the Mountain
  • Advanced (1): Flow Within the Mountain

Base rating-tracker for the Visceratika Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
